title: 7:18 Lord shall whistle. The Lord will signal or prompt the Assyrian armies (here referred to as "bees") to come down on Judah. The Lord shall whistle to the bees is a symbol built on an actual ancient practice, for Cyrillus of Alexandria (ca. a.d. 400) wrote about beekeepers who whistled to bees to get them to return to their hives. 24
author: Tina M. Peterson
